review_scope: Technical comparison of all 23 Forward+ pairs against the tracked publication. Material records matched by stable path for visibly changed interior reflections and ambient light. The separate F03 installed comparison isolates shaft shadow mode at a fixed viewpoint.

images.observation: Ceiling pendant, worktable, floor boards and threshold retain their outlines and warm light pools.
Spotlight edge, tiles and curtain read consistently in the reflected view.
Resident, window, furniture and floor retain their draw order and outlines.
Window, furniture, floor pattern and warm beam remain readable.
Dither pattern differs at the beam edge. Cabinet, sink and backsplash remain continuous, and all 11 matched named draw paths retain their material metadata.
Boiler door, gauge, pipes and stand remain present with their shadow shapes.
The seat and table are darker. Bookcase shelves, ladder and the doorway stay legible.
Tile seams, vent joint and visible fixture edges persist at the same positions.
Brick joints retain detail in the dark dumbwaiter view.
Door face and fittings catch a darker light sample. Sockets and conduit keep their shapes, and all 24 matched named draw paths retain their materials.
The floor, rail and foreground surfaces retain the same occlusion and finish.
Shelf, figurine and frame silhouettes remain visible in the low bar light.
Shelf trim, wall frames and rear practical maintain their edges and color separation.
Metal doors show more localized reflections and the bench is darker. The bank, card rows and bench remain present. Matched fixed-bank lettering and card materials agree.
Nearby worktop reflection is darker. Radiator fins and valves remain present, and all 26 matched named draw paths retain their materials.
Rail uprights, drive-room door and ceiling hardware remain visible around the landing.
Tank, braces, parapet and distant buildings preserve their silhouettes.
Register lid catches less reflected light. Counter, slips and trim stay present, and all 55 matched named register draws retain their materials.
Tile seams and visible fixture edges remain continuous in the warm service light.
The pool stays visible within the beam, with the radiator and boards framing the same contact area.
The root and tentacle remain separated from the radiator and lit floor.
Appliance face and cans render darker, with the slots, crumbs and counter intact. All 11 matched named toaster draws retain their materials.
Station face is darker and wall lighting is more mottled. Plate and latch stay visible. All 83 matched named watch-area draws retain their materials.
